title: Do Boat Trips in Madeira Run When It Rains?
description: Usually, yes. Rain alone does not decide a boat trip in Madeira: the sea, the wind and thunderstorms do. When trips go, when they stop and what to wear.
heroAlt: Passing rain shower over the sea near Câmara de Lobos, seen from a boat deck
keywords: do boat trips in Madeira run when it rains
how often does it rain in Funchal
rain on the south coast of Madeira
what to wear on a boat trip in the rain

images.prompt: From the deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking towards Câmara de Lobos on a showery winter morning. Drops of rain bead on the grey cushions in the foreground. Out on the water, a grey curtain of rain falls over the sea while sunlight breaks through behind it onto the colourful houses and the cliffs. Two passengers in light rain jackets, seen from behind and small, sit under the dark canopy. Realistic photo, true colours, soft wet light, no text.
